request:
Create one high-resolution 16:9 natural editorial photograph of a quiet alpine lake visitor terrace in clear late-afternoon light. This is a clean scene reference for a later visual-transformation demonstration, so the scene must be coherent and readily inspectable rather than fantastical.

Composition from a standing human camera: a pale stone terrace fills the lower third; on the left is one small modern visitor pavilion with a low flat roof, glass door, vertical timber cladding, and a broad blank light-stone wall facing the camera. One long simple timber bench runs parallel to the lake at center-right. A slender dark metal lamp stands beside the bench. A low metal guardrail follows the terrace edge, interrupted by a broad central path descending gently toward the shore. The lake occupies the middle distance, with a single small red canoe near the right shore. Layered pine-covered mountains fill the upper background, a craggy mountain summit offset left, a blue sky with a few light clouds. Warm sunlight from the right, believable shadows toward left, calm blue-green water. No people, animals, logos, lettering, flags, sculptures, screens or clutter. Natural restrained colors and authentic material textures. Every object has coherent scale, perspective and contact. No black-and-gold branding or stylization. Output only the photograph, not a diagram or contact sheet.
